Chapter 516: Chapter 13 Comprehending The Complete Space Rules (Subscription Requested)_2

Chapter 516: Chapter 13 Comprehending the Complete Space Rules (Subscription Requested)_2

“Now, let me introduce the battlefield situation to the Galactic Star Master,” Baiyun Lord said.

“Please do,” Lin Yuan nodded.

“Currently, on the battlefield, the Tianyu Clan holds the advantage, with sixty-seven invincible experts of the Eighth Layer, and in addition two hundred and twelve Layer A war machines, as well as two thousand three hundred normal Eighth Layer experts…”

“Up to now, we human Evolvers can only struggle to counter the Tianyu Clan’s offensive. However, in the upcoming all-out war, if nothing changes, I estimate that our human side will be defeated.”

Baiyun Lord’s voice was grave; once the Tianyu Clan was victorious, the Evolvers of human civilization would face a great escape, even those who were invincible at the Eighth Layer could not guarantee their safe retreat.

It’s almost impossible for one Eighth Layer invincible being to be defeated by another of the same rank. However, on the Battlefields of Different Races, due to obvious space fluctuations, those at the Eighth Layer cannot use instant translocation abilities.

...

Once trapped in an encirclement by multiple opponents of the same rank, even an Eighth Layer invincible might face the possibility of falling.

Of course, the Eighth Layer invincibles who dare to enter the battlefield are mostly Avatars, but cultivating an Avatar that is close to the strength of the original is not an easy task.

The fall of an Avatar is a huge loss for the original.

After all, to maintain the combat power of an Avatar, it’s necessary to carry weapons of the same rank.

And these weapons are not cheap.

“So that’s how it is,” Lin Yuan nodded.

The situation was as he had expected; if human civilization was in an advantageous position on the battlefield, there would be no need to request his assistance with a large payment of Merit Points.

“How much time do we have before the all-out war begins?”

Lin Yuan inquired.

“It’s estimated to be between five and ten years,” Baiyun Lord pondered for a moment and said.

The Tianyu Clan would need a considerable amount of time to mobilize for a full-scale war, and Baiyun Lord guessed it would be at least five years.

If any unexpected events occurred, it might even take ten years.

“I understand,” Lin Yuan nodded, “I will rush to the battlefield within five years.”

Naturally, Lin Yuan’s rush to the battlefield meant that his Avatar would, while his True Body would still sit at the Milky Way Main Star.

Although Lin Yuan’s Primordial Spirit, unlike the Doppelganger Skill practiced by other human Evolvers, wouldn’t die if the original fell, the resurrection would happen within the Primordial Spirit.

However, Lin Yuan’s true original body had too many things to do and naturally couldn’t afford to go to the battlefield.

Indeed, with Lin Yuan’s current strength, even as an Avatar, without the enhancement of a hundred million li inner World, he could still crush all Eighth Layer invincibles.

“Thank you, Galactic Star Master,” Baiyun Lord immediately expressed his gratitude.

“However, which of the Tianyu Clan’s experts does the Galactic Star Master plan to deal with?” Baiyun Lord asked.

The power of the invincibles of the Tianyu Clan varied in strength, so Baiyun Lord needed to confirm the range of Lin Yuan’s targets.

“How many can you handle?” Lin Yuan asked.

“We can probably deal with fifty of the Tianyu Clan’s Eighth Layer invincibles,” Baiyun Lord said after pondering for a while.

“No problem.”

“Leave the rest of the Eighth Layer invincibles to me,” Lin Yuan nodded.

“The rest are nearly twenty Eighth Layer invincibles…” Baiyun Lord was somewhat surprised.

He originally thought Lin Yuan would find it challenging since nearly twenty Eighth Layer invincibles, even just to hold off, would be incredibly unbelievable.

If Lin Yuan hadn’t achieved the impressive feat of slaying two Eighth Layer invincibles, Baiyun Lord would have found it absurd.

“Rest assured, I know what I’m doing,” Lin Yuan said.

Even as an Avatar, mastering dozens of Cosmic Forces would allow him to unleash combat power that could surpass a union of twenty Eighth Layer invincibles.

Furthermore, based on Lin Yuan’s estimation, in five years, with the aid of “Void Interpretation,” he would likely have fully grasped the Complete Space Rules.

By then, his combat power would increase even further.

It was known that for an Eighth Layer being to comprehend the Complete Space Rules was much harder than understanding a particular Cosmic Force.

At the same time, an Eighth Layer being who comprehended the Complete Space Rules would be stronger than the invincible ones of the same rank.

In history, every Eighth Layer being who had grasped the Complete Space Rules at that level was able to intimidate the other invincibles of their rank.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit emerged from the Thirteen Peaks and headed toward the B0001 Exotic Battlefield.

Leaving the Taiyang Divine Spirit on the Chikun Main Star was primarily to prevent extreme situations where Lin Yuan’s true body might perish, allowing him to resurrect and return at the fastest speed.

In fact, even without the Taiyang Divine Spirit stationed on the Chikun Main Star, Lin Yuan could still resurrect.

After all, aside from the Taiyang Divine Spirit, Lin Yuan had also left a drop of his essence blood on the Chikun Main Star.

By utilizing the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Blood Rebirth,’ Lin Yuan could still resurrect, though without the assistance of the Taiyang Divine Spirit, the resurrection process would be somewhat slower.

In fact, not just on the Chikun Main Star, Lin Yuan had left a drop of his essence blood in many hidden places, serving as a ‘backup’ for resurrection.

“It will probably take three years to reach the B0001 battlefield…” The Taiyang Divine Spirit boarded the spaceship, continuously performing Wormhole Shuttle, rapidly heading toward its target.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness descended into his inner world.

“World Tree…”

Lin Yuan gazed at a young tree rooted in the world’s center.

Compared to the very beginning, the World Tree was no longer ‘young,’ standing nearly ten meters tall. Its branches swayed, emanating the gentle cosmic force, continually harmonizing the many energies and rules within the inner world.

“It truly deserves the Human Civilization’s designation as Eleven-Star top-grade cosmic rare treasure…”

Lin Yuan looked toward the World Tree, a smile appearing on his face.

In Human Civilization’s evaluation of various treasures and rarities, the World Tree was ranked as Eleven-Star, and it was a premium among the Eleven-Star rarities.

To think, the Thunder Heart that Lin Yuan had previously purchased for over ten thousand Cubic Universe Crystals was only an Eight-Star rarity; an Eleven-Star rarity… furthermore, a premium Eleven-Star, would probably make even Supreme Beings envious.

“With the World Tree anchoring the inner world, I also won’t need to purchase any more cosmic rare treasures…” Lin Yuan secretly thought to himself.

Integrating many cosmic rare treasures into the inner world aimed at bringing the inner world closer to a true world, but with the World Tree’s suppression, the inner world was already hardly any different from a real world.

…

Time passed by.

In the blink of an eye, three years had gone by.

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with silver-white characters continuously flashing through his mind.

“Space…”

Lin Yuan, too, was comprehending, feeling the vastness of space more and more; the Main World Universe Starry Sky belonged to space, and even beyond the universe was still considered space.

Even if one were to fully comprehend the complete Space Rules, it would merely be grasping one aspect of the vast space.

“The Demonic Jade Tower Master’s understanding of space has transcended any particular aspect. Though it’s not as straightforward as the space model in explaining the essence of space, at higher levels, ‘Void Interpretation’ is still more helpful to me…”

Lin Yuan faintly felt that he had grasped one facet of the essence of space.

The many space models of Human Civilization were more broadly disseminated, making them more acceptable and understandable for Evolvers,

while the ‘Void Interpretation’ written by the Demonic Jade Tower Master, without the talent and insight for space, it was estimated that one couldn’t even begin to comprehend it.

“The 7779th kind of space model…”

“The 7780th kind of space model…”

“The 7781st kind of space model…”

Lin Yuan felt his grasp and understanding of space skyrocketing at a tremendous speed. Three years of contemplating ‘Void Interpretation’ greatly aided Lin Yuan.

Even if it was just a period of contemplation followed by a period of rest, it had an indelible impact on Lin Yuan’s understanding of the essence of Space Rules.

Time flew by.

Another five days passed in the blink of an eye.

“Hahaha…” Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes, looking up into the depths of the cosmic starry sky, where all space unfolded before him like sheets of paper.

Lin Yuan could even effortlessly tear through one of these sheets and appear before a distant and separate sheet.

“Great Transference Skill, this is the Great Transference Skill.”

Lin Yuan chuckled softly to himself. Having penetrated the complete Space Rules, he could traverse hundreds of light-years in a single step. This was the Great Transference Skill.

“Marvelous, truly indescribable.”

Lin Yuan sighed, now thoroughly comprehending one aspect of space, mastering the complete Space Rules.
